fnol_description: Heavy rain overnight; water came in under the back door and through a basement window well. Basement carpet and drywall soaked.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-131
adjuster_notes.text: Spoke to the insured, Dana Whitlock, at the property, 27 Larkspur Lane. About 90 mm of rain fell in three hours. Surface water ran off the neighbouring field, pooled against the rear wall and came in through the basement window well and under the rear door. No river, stream or lake near the house; the creek half a mile away stayed within its banks.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-131
adjuster_notes.text: While carrying boxes up from the basement, Ms. Whitlock slipped on the wet stairs and sprained her left wrist; she was treated at Westbrook Urgent Care. Noted for the file only; no liability claim made.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-131
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate agreed: basement carpet $4,200, drywall and paint $3,900, dehumidifier hire $650. Total $8,750.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-131
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under NG-1101 ed. 07-23 WE-4 (rainwater and surface runoff); E-42 does not apply because no body of water overflowed. Covered loss $8,750 less the $1,000 deductible = $7,750, within the WE-4 sublimit of $10,000. Payable $7,750. Reason code COV-WE4.

fnol_description: Rainstorm on New Year's Eve; water ran down the driveway and into the garage-level den.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-118
adjuster_notes.text: Storm on 31 December 2025, roughly 70 mm of rain. The driveway slopes toward the house and runoff entered the den under the garage-side door. No watercourse overflowed anywhere in the area. Drying started the same night with fans the insured owns.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-118
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: den flooring $3,900, skirting and paint $1,300, contents (sofa, rug) $900. Total $6,100. No mold found.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-118
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under NG-1101 ed. 07-23 WE-4, the edition in force on the 2025-12-31 date of loss; the 01-26 edition, which treats runoff as excluded under E-42, took effect the next day and does not apply. $6,100 less the $500 deductible = $5,600, within the $10,000 WE-4 sublimit. Reason code COV-WE4.

fnol_description: Rain overnight into New Year's Day; surface water came in through the back door into the kitchen.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-118
adjuster_notes.text: Rain ran from the evening of 31 December into the early hours of 1 January 2026. Insured says the water came in at about 03:00 on 1 January, when runoff from the road crossed the yard and entered under the kitchen door. No watercourse overflowed.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-118
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: kitchen flooring $4,400, lower cabinets $2,100. Total $6,500.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-118
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: denied under NG-1101 ed. 01-26 E-42 (surface water and flood: runoff entering from outside). The loss happened on 2026-01-01, when the 01-26 edition was in force; the 07-23 WE-4 runoff cover ended on 2025-12-31. Deductible $1,000. Reason code EXC-E42.

fnol_description: Pipe burst in the upstairs bathroom wall; water came through the ceiling below. Mold found a week later.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Copper supply line in the bathroom wall split overnight; the insured found water coming through the dining-room ceiling at 07:00 and shut the main valve. Drying contractor started within 36 hours.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Mold found behind the wall cavity during tear-out. Hygienist confirms it grew from this escape of water; no sign of earlier leaks.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: ceiling and drywall $3,400; mold remediation $9,200.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: water damage covered under NG-1101 ed. 01-26 WE-1: $3,400 less $1,000 deductible = $2,400. Mold covered under NG-1103 ed. 07-23 MR-1 (drying began within 48 hours), capped at the MR-2 sublimit of $5,000; the 02-26 edition with its $7,500 sublimit took effect on 2026-02-01, after the date of loss. Total payable $7,400. Reason code COV-MR2.

fnol_description: Water came up through the family room floor; a pipe under the slab broke.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Visited the insured, Tomasz Wierzbicki, at 9 Quarry Road. Leak detection found the cold water line under the slab sheared.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Engineer's report: the slab dropped about 3 cm at the west corner after ground subsidence over an old mine working; the line sheared because the slab moved. The insured's son twisted his ankle on the lifted floor tiles; no treatment needed beyond rest.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: flooring and drywall $6,800; slab and line repair $3,500.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-121
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: the 2026-02-14 date of loss falls under NG-1105 ed. 07-23 (the 03-26 edition took effect on 2026-03-01). Under GM-3 of ed. 07-23 the water damage is given back: flooring and drywall $6,800 covered under NG-1101 ed. 01-26 WE-1, less $1,000 deductible = $5,800 payable. Slab and line repair $3,500 denied under NG-1105 ed. 07-23 E-81. Reason code COV-GM3.

fnol_description: Frozen pipe burst at a holiday cottage while it was empty.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Cottage was unoccupied from 2025-11-05 until the caretaker found the burst on 2025-12-20: 45 days. Heating was switched off and the system was not drained. A pipe in the utility room split and water ran through the ground floor.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: floors and skirting $5,600, plaster and paint $1,700, pipe repair $400.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: covered under NG-1101 ed. 07-23 WE-1. E-44 in ed. 07-23 applies only after more than 60 days unoccupied; this cottage was empty 45 days. (The 01-26 edition's 30-day threshold was not in force on 2025-12-20.) Pipe repair $400 denied under E-45. Covered $7,300 less $1,000 deductible = $6,300 payable. Reason code COV-WE1.

fnol_description: Washing machine hose burst; laundry room and hallway flooded.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Hose split at the tap connector while the machine ran; water ran for about 30 minutes. Laundry and hallway floors wet.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: flooring $3,800, skirting and paint $900.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-104
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: declined. No cover was in force on the 2025-11-02 date of loss: the policy was cancelled for non-payment with effect from 2025-10-15. Coverage wording not reached. Reason code NIF-CANCELLED.

fnol_description: Water heater failed and flooded the basement utility room.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Insured says the water heater tank failed on 26 February and she found the basement wet that evening. Policy shows inception 2025-03-01; the insured says she bought the house on 20 February and arranged cover the following week.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Estimate: utility room flooring and drywall $2,900, water heater $1,250.

adjuster_notes.author: adj-117
adjuster_notes.text: Decision: declined. The loss on 2025-02-26 happened before the policy incepted on 2025-03-01, so no cover was in force. Reason code NIF-PRE-INCEPTION.
